annotations.title: YC SAFE Pro Rata & MFN Side Letter Dilution Calculator

description: Models YC post-money SAFE dilution, 1x or 2x pro rata side letter reserves in Series A, and MFN cap repricing risk. Same math as https://modevc.com/tools/yc-safe-pro-rata-side-letter-calculator.

later_lower_cap_usd.description: Lowest subsequent SAFE cap in USD. Default 6000000.

mfn_enabled.description: True if MFN clause reprices to lower later cap. Default true.

other_cap_usd.description: Average cap of other SAFEs in USD. Default 8000000.

other_safes_usd.description: Other stacked SAFEs USD total. Default 400000.

safe_amount_usd.description: This SAFE amount in USD. Default 1000000.

safe_cap_usd.description: Post-money SAFE cap in USD. Default 8000000.

series_a_pre_usd.description: Series A pre-money in USD. Default 16000000.

series_a_raise_usd.description: Series A raise in USD. Default 4000000.
